question: In Slack: Archive the channel that our workspace owner belongs to, that was created before March 2026, and that only has 5 members. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked. Victor Reyes (workspace owner) belongs to three channels:

- **general** — created 2026-04-01 (after March 2026, so out)
- **proj-comet** — created 2026-02-12, but only 4 members
- **watercooler** — created 2026-01-01, but only 2 members

No channel matches all three criteria (owner's channel + created before March 2026 + exactly 5 members), so nothing was archived.

import json, subprocess, datetime

def api(method, data):
    data = dict(data); data['token'] = '<TOKEN>'
    p = subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-X','POST',f'https://slack.com/api/{method}','-H','Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'],
                       input=urllib_encode(data), capture_output=True, text=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

from urllib.parse import urlencode
def urllib_encode(d): return urlencode(d)

cutoff = int(datetime.datetime(2026,3,1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
print('cutoff ts:', cutoff, datetime.datetime(2026,3,1,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc))

cursor = ''
channels = []
while True:
    d = api('users.conversations', {
        'user': 'UOBRCZJBAIG',
        'exclude_archived': 'true',
        'types': 'public_channel,private_channel',
        'limit': '1000',
        'include_num_members': 'true',
    } | ({'cursor': cursor} if cursor else {}))
    if not d.get('ok'):
        print('ERR', d); break
    channels.extend(d.get('channels', []))
    cursor = d.get('response_metadata', {}).get('next_cursor', '')
    if not cursor: break

print('total channels:', len(channels))
for c in channels:
    nm = c.get('num_members')
    created = c.get('created', 0)
    flag = ''
    if created < cutoff and nm == 5:
        flag = '  <== MATCH (created before Mar 2026, 5 members)'
    print(c['id'], c.get('name'), '| created:', datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(created).isoformat(), '| members:', nm, '| archived:', c.get('is_archived'), flag)
EOF
